name: Northern Territory
summary: A black vertical band with the Southern Cross in white at the hoist, and an ochre field with a stylised Sturt's desert rose in the fly. Designed by Robert Ingpen for self-government in 1978.
origin: The flag was designed by the artist Robert Ingpen and adopted on 1 July 1978, when the Northern Territory gained self-government. It is the only Australian state or territory flag without the Union Flag.

symbols.name: Southern Cross
symbols.meaning: The territory's place in Australia and the southern sky.

symbols.name: Sturt's desert rose
symbols.description: A stylised white flower with a black seven-pointed star centre.
symbols.meaning: The territory's floral emblem; the star echoes the Commonwealth Star.

facts: It is the only Australian state or territory flag without the Union Flag.
Its colours (black, ochre and white) reflect the landscape and Aboriginal art.
clues: A black band with the Southern Cross beside an ochre field with a desert flower.
